scope_lock.source: docs/core-business-catalog.md handbook contract and docs/handbook.md quick-sale consultation flow
in_scope: Tenant-scoped disease search for the quick-sale counter by name, alias, target, and symptom
Tenant-scoped suggestion endpoint using pinned products, recommended ingredients, and matching product tags
Sellable/in-stock filtering and clear advisory metadata without auto-adding to cart
Optional consultation fields and simple transparent quantity metadata submitted by the counter
Immutable disease, consultation, selected suggestion, warning, and quantity snapshots on POST /tenant/sales/quick
Quick-sale frontend flow: search disease, optionally consult, review suggestions, manually add products, then checkout
Focused backend/frontend tests and runtime reachability evidence
out_of_scope: AI diagnosis, image recognition, external registries, or medical/agronomic validation
Automatic cart insertion or automatic quantity acceptance
Two-layer fallback by active ingredient, advanced formula engine, reminders, or customer-history ranking
New product-kind schemas, batch lifecycle changes, or redesign of existing handbook CRUD
Editing snapshots after a completed quick sale
